The prototype at **http://maker:4001** now keeps viewable copies. Please try:

**1 — A preserved copy.** On most cards you'll see a **🗎 Saved copy** action. Click it — it opens a stand-in "preserved copy" page showing when it was saved and a link back to the original. *(This is a simulated copy in the prototype; the real app captures the actual page content at save time.)*

**2 — A PDF.** The **Annual Whitepaper (PDF)** card shows **🗎 Saved PDF** — the copy keeps the PDF itself.

**3 — Internet Archive.** The Smashing Magazine card also shows an **Internet Archive** link (a public snapshot). To create one yourself: save a new link and, in the editor, turn on **"Also save a copy to the Internet Archive."**

**4 — Choosing not to keep a copy / adding one later.** In the editor you'll see **"Keep a viewable copy of this page"** (on by default). Save a link with it **off**, and the card will show a **Save a copy** action so you can capture one later.

Decisions to judge:
- **On by default:** keeping a viewable copy is on automatically; the Internet Archive copy is opt-in. Right defaults?
- **Where the copies live:** small actions on the card (Saved copy / Saved PDF / Internet Archive). Does that placement work?
- **Honesty check:** given real capture/archiving depends on outside services, are you comfortable settling the *behaviour* now and treating the actual capturing (and its limits) as part of the build?

Once you're happy, the last two areas are **import/export of bookmarks** (E-7) and **display preferences** (E-8).
